risk_if_not_implemented: Without Third-Party Knowledge & Operational Transfer, knowledge, documentation, configurations, credentials and operational responsibilities may leave with the provider, degrading the organization's ability to operate and secure the affected services. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), Uncontrolled Third-Party Security / Privacy Exposure (R-GV-5), Loss of Critical Knowledge / Capability (R-PE-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Supplier Financial Distress / Insolvency (MT-24), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Manage Organizational Knowledge
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to manage the organizational knowledge of the security, compliance and resilience staff.
compensating_control_1.justification: Manage Organizational Knowledge (PRM-11) compensates for the absence of Third-Party Knowledge & Operational Transfer (TPM-24.5) by capturing and retaining organizational knowledge as a managed asset, which preserves the operational understanding that would otherwise be lost when a provider departs. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Responsible, Accountable, Supportive, Consulted & Informed (RASCI) Matrix
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to document and maintain a Responsible, Accountable, Supportive, Consulted & Informed (RASCI) matrix, or similar documentation, to delineate assignment for security, compliance and resilience controls between internal stakeholders and External Service Providers (ESPs).
compensating_control_2.justification: Responsible, Accountable, Supportive, Consulted & Informed (RASCI) Matrix (TPM-11) compensates for the absence of Third-Party Knowledge & Operational Transfer (TPM-24.5) by documenting a Responsible, Accountable, Supportive, Consulted & Informed (RASCI) matrix for third-party controls, which identifies the responsibilities that must be reassigned internally before cessation. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
